summary: A high-performance personal portfolio website featuring a minimalist monochrome design and an optimized project showcase. It is built with React, TypeScript, and Vite, utilizing Tailwind CSS for styling and Netlify for deployment.

components.name: Navigation & Layout
components.purpose: Handles site-wide navigation, sticky headers, and responsive layout structures.

components.name: Project Showcase
components.purpose: Displays a list of projects and detailed case studies via dynamic routing.

components.name: SEO & Metadata
components.purpose: Manages dynamic meta tags, JSON-LD structured data, and search engine visibility.

components.name: Resume Preview System
components.purpose: Converts PDF resumes into optimized WebP images at build time for fast loading.

components.name: User Feedback
components.purpose: Provides toast notifications for user interactions.

decisions: Used createBrowserRouter and RouterProvider for compatibility with React Router v7 upgrades.
Implemented a build-time script to render PDF pages to WebP to optimize asset delivery and performance.
Utilized lazy loading and Suspense for route-based code splitting.
Applied custom security headers via netlify.toml including X-Frame-Options and X-XSS-Protection.
risks: Client-side routing may cause issues with direct URL access if the Netlify redirect rule (/* to /index.html) is misconfigured.
The use of 'any' in the RouterProvider future prop bypasses TypeScript safety.
Large project data in src/data/projects.ts increases bundle size as the portfolio grows.
